whenToUse: The sidebar of a news, magazine or blog site: popular posts, recent comments, categories with counts, follower counts.
A main column + sidebar grid with a sticky tail (NewsColumns).
avoidWhen: App dashboards — use card and stat.
A single list of articles — use blog-list.
a11y: Each widget is a labelled section; counts are announced in full, not as compact "12K".
The sidebar stacks under the main column on narrow screens, keeping reading order.
